name: Engineering plastics (polycarbonate, nylon)
principle: Polycarbonate is made from bisphenol A and phosgene (interfacial) or diphenyl carbonate (melt), and nylons from diamines and diacids or lactams. The sources found so far give company activity only: Covestro started a recyclate compounding plant at its Shanghai site in October 2023 (capacity not stated in the page read).

sources.note: Plastics Europe news, Covestro starts first Chinese recyclate compounding plant, 20 October 2023 (opening paragraph only; paywalled)
